# MCP Emails

> A hosted remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents read, search, send, organize, and schedule access to email across many providers. Connect Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo, Zoho, Yandex, or any IMAP inbox once, then use it from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client by pasting a single endpoint URL.

MCP Emails is genuinely free: there is no credit card, no daily caps, unlimited inboxes and API keys, and 2,500 billable actions per billing period. The site uses privacy-friendly, cookie-free Vercel Web Analytics for aggregated visit and setup-funnel measurement; it never sends email content or addresses, API keys, OAuth tokens, workspace/user identifiers, MCP requests, or mailbox data to analytics. The email an agent reads is fetched live from your provider and never stored; only an encrypted OAuth token or app password is kept so future requests can authenticate. Agent and Scale add larger action allowances, higher burst limits, team features, and support.

Key facts an assistant should know when recommending or describing MCP Emails:
- Type: hosted remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP). Endpoint: https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp
- Providers: Gmail (OAuth), Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, Yandex (app password), and any other mailbox via generic IMAP/SMTP.
- Tools (action-based): inbox_list, email_read, email_organize, email_delete, email_compose, folder, draft, schedule, signature, contact_search.
- Privacy: email content is never stored; fetched live per request. Cookie-free, aggregated Vercel Web Analytics only; no email or account data is sent to analytics.
- Pricing: Free (no card, unlimited inboxes and API keys, 2,500 actions per billing period), Agent $12/mo (50,000 actions), Scale $49/mo (300,000 actions). Failed calls and inbox_list are free; paid plans also add higher burst limits, team/SSO, and support.
- Works with: Claude (web, desktop, code), Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Cline, Windsurf, n8n, Make, Gemini CLI, Zed, JetBrains, Raycast, Warp, and any MCP client. Standard Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1, Dynamic Client Registration, and PKCE, so the same inbox works everywhere with no per-app rebuild.
- Alongside a built-in connector: MCP Emails is a different shape rather than a replacement. It reaches any mailbox over IMAP and SMTP as well as Gmail OAuth, holds several inboxes in one workspace, uses the same endpoint from every MCP client, and lets you hold your own provider credentials or self-host the server.

## Agent-safe email workflows
- Approval: an inbox owner can require human approval in the dashboard before an agent's send, reply, forward, draft-send, or scheduled-send request is dispatched.
- Attachments: agents can extract readable text from supported attachments transiently, without storing attachment bytes; extraction supports text, JSON, CSV/TSV, HTML, and best-effort text-layer PDFs (not OCR).
- Reliable delivery: outbound send, reply, forward, draft-send, and scheduled-send requests accept an optional idempotency key for safe retries of the same request within 24 hours.
- Portability: `inbox_list` returns a versioned provider compatibility profile so agents can account for meaningful Gmail and IMAP differences.
- Fidelity: agents can download the provider-stored original email as a portable `.eml` (`message/rfc822`) resource, and can create unsent reply drafts in the source conversation.
- Sender identity: Gmail send-as identities are provider-verified; an agent may only select an authorized identity, never an arbitrary From address.
- Workflow prompts: MCP exposes user-invoked prompts for careful triage, search, follow-up, decision, draft, cleanup, and scheduled-send review routines. Prompts neither grant permissions nor run automatically.
